data.long_meaning: The name Dayaal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'daya' which means 'compassion' or 'mercy'. This name is given to a child who is believed to possess the qualities of kindness, generosity, and benevolence. The name Dayaal carries the meaning “Compassionate, Benevolent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dayaal usually hope their child will grow to embody compassionate, benevolent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
